chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hatim narrated to us. He said: Harun ibn Ishaq al-Hamdani narrated to me. He said: Abda ibn Sulayman narrated to me. He said: Kamil ibn al-Ala narrated to us. He said: Habib ibn Abi Thabit narrated to us, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Abdullah ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him):

O Ali! You are the master of my Pond, the bearer of my standard, the fulfiller of my promises, the beloved of my heart, and the inheritor of my knowledge. You are the custodian of the prophets' inheritance. You are the trustee of God in His earth. You are the Proof of God over His creatures. You are the pillar of faith, the lamp in the darkness, the lighthouse of guidance, and the raised banner for the people of this world.

Whoever follows you is saved, and whoever turns away from you perishes. You are the clear road and the Straight Path. You are the leader of the luminous shining believers. You are the chief of the believers. You are the master of everyone of whom I am master, and I am the master of every believing man and woman.
None shall love you except one who is pure of birth, and none shall hate you except one who is impure of birth.

My Lord — Mighty and Majestic — never raised me up to heaven and spoke to me without saying to me: 'O Muhammad! Convey to Ali My greetings, and make him know that he is the Imam of My friends and the light of the people of My obedience.'
Congratulations to you, O Ali, for this honour.

key_terms.الصراط المستقيم: The Straight Path — a direct Quranic reference (1:6) applied to Ali
key_terms.حجة الله: Proof of God — a central Shia theological title for the Imam
key_terms.حوضي: The Prophet's Pond (Kawthar) in paradise — a key eschatological concept
key_terms.طاهر الولادة: Pure of birth — linked to Shia belief in the purity of Ali's lineage
key_terms.مولى: Master/patron — the key term from the Ghadir declaration
key_terms.يعسوب المؤمنين: Ya'sub of the believers — chief/king-bee, a distinctive title for Ali

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Ali ibn Abi Talib about his status and role?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) praising Imam Ali (AS) with a series of exalted titles and attributes in the presence of Abdullah ibn Abbas. The Prophet declares that Ali is his successor, the custodian of prophetic inheritance, the Proof of God on earth, and the Straight Path — and that God Himself greets Ali during every celestial ascension of the Prophet. This text was narrated in the assembly of Shaykh al-Saduq in 368 AH and reflects the Shia theological understanding of Ali's unique spiritual and juridical authority.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Hatim narrated to us. He said: Harun b. Ishaq al-Hamadani narrated to me. He said: `Abda b. Sulayman narrated to me. He said: Kamil b. al-`Ala’ narrated to us. He said: Habib b Abi Thabit narrated to us from Sa`id b. Jubayr from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said to `Ali b. Abi Talib (as):

O `Ali! You are the master of my Pond, my standard bearer, the one who faces my enemies, the beloved of my heart, and the inheritor of my knowledge. You are the place of the inheritance of the prophets. You are the trustee of Allah in His Earth. You are the Proof of Allah over His creatures. You are the pillar of faith, the lantern in the darkness, the light post of guidance, and the raised flag for the people of this world.

Whoever follows you is saved, and whoever turns away from you is destroyed. You are the clear road and the Straight Path. You are the Leader of the shining believers. You are the chief of the believers. You are the Master of everyone I am a Master of, and I am the Master of every believing man and woman.
None will love you except he who is pure of birth, and none will hate you except he who is impure of birth.

My Lord did not raise me up to heaven and speak to me except that He said to me: “O Muhammad! Recite My salaam to `Ali and make him recognize that he is the Imam of My friends and the light of the people of My obedience.”
Congratulations to you, `Ali, for this honour.
